pairs: William Goldman (he wrote the movie too!)
story: A grandfather reads his sick grandson a storybook about Buttercup, the most beautiful girl in the world, and Westley, the farm boy who loves her. When Buttercup is kidnapped by three outlaws, a mysterious man in black scales the Cliffs of Insanity to rescue her. Sword fights, a giant, a six-fingered villain, miracles, and true love: this book has everything.
trivia: Cary Elwes and Mandy Patinkin trained for months to do the giant sword duel themselves, learning to fence with BOTH hands.
Fezzik is Andre the Giant, a 7-foot-4 wrestling superstar. The whole cast loved him, and Robin Wright says he kept everyone warm on cold days.
Vizzini is Wallace Shawn. You know his voice: he is Rex the nervous dinosaur in Toy Story.
Mandy Patinkin says his only injury was a bruised rib, from holding in his laughter at Billy Crystal's Miracle Max.

questions: The movie keeps stopping the fairy tale to show Grandpa reading to the grandson. Why keep them in it instead of telling the story straight?
The grandson thinks a kissing book sounds terrible, but at the end he asks Grandpa to read it again tomorrow. What changed his mind?
Inigo spent his whole life on revenge, and when it is done he does not know what to do next. Was it worth it? What should he do now?
